name: Prone
description: Lying on the ground: −2 to action checks. Standing up is a Minor Action (and −2 until the end of that turn).

name: Surprised
description: Ambushed: no Combat Preparation and −2 to every check until the start of the next turn.

name: Full Move
description: Ran with a Full Move: −4 to Evasion until the start of the next turn; no Major Action this turn.

name: Preparing to Withdraw
description: Declared to leave the skirmish: −4 to Evasion until the start of the next turn, then may move backwards out of melee.

name: Asleep (Nap)
description: Light sleep (Psychic, weak): cannot act; −4 if a check is forced. Ends when touched or when damaged.

name: Blind
description: Cannot see: −4 to action checks; everything counts as invisible to the character.

name: Darkness
description: No light source indoors/underground: −4 to action checks (no penalty with darkvision).

name: Dim Light
description: Moonlight/starlight, fog or sandstorm: −2 to action checks (no penalty with darkvision for darkness).

name: Poor Footing
description: Mud, ice, nets or vines: −2 to action checks.

name: Waist-deep Water
description: −2 to action checks, half movement, no Full Move.

name: Underwater
description: Submerged or shoulder-deep: −4 to action checks, ¼ movement, no ranged attacks, spellsongs or finales; fully submerged cannot breathe or speak.

name: Invisible
description: Cannot be targeted directly except from the same skirmish; attacks against it take −4 Accuracy and its attacks impose −4 Evasion. Modeled as +4 to its own Evasion and Accuracy checks (the same in a contested roll).

name: Entangled
description: Held or entangled: cannot move. Escape with a Major Action: 2d + Adventurer level + STR modifier against the capturing check's success value.

name: Paralyzed
description: Paralysis marker — apply the penalties of the effect that caused it.

name: Poisoned
description: Under a poison-type effect (removed by Cure Poison / antidotes).

name: Diseased
description: Under a disease-type effect (removed by Cure Disease).

name: Cursed
description: Under a curse-type effect (only Remove Curse or similar ends it).

name: Charmed
description: Psychic-type charm effect.

name: Frightened
description: Psychic-type fear effect.

name: Hungry / Sleepless
description: A day without a meal or 3 hours of sleep: −1 to all checks and −1 max HP and MP (stacks per missed day).

name: Petrifying
description: Petrifaction in progress: the listed ability score is reduced each time; at 0 the character is petrified. Fixed-value creatures take −1 per −6 and are petrified after three applications.

name: Petrified
description: Turned to stone: no actions; needs Cure Stone or a Cure Stone Potion.

name: Alternate Form
description: Nightmare Alternate Form: no armor penalty to spellcasting, no need to speak or draw magic characters.

name: Beast Form
description: Lykant Beast Form: +2 Strength modifier; speaks only Lycant; no Truespeech, Spiritualism, Magitech or Fairy Magic.

name: Lildraken Flight
description: Wings of the Wind: flying, +1 to melee Accuracy and Evasion; no Full Move (until adventurer level 6).
